name: alize-payroll-platform
description: Alize Enterprise Payroll & HRMS Platform with Indian Statutory Compliance

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix backend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
